description: This file defines protocols related to streaming audio playback and their extensions in a Swift project. It specifies interfaces for generic streaming audio playback and PCM-specific streaming playback, including asynchronous play and stop methods. The file also extends existing classes to conform to these protocols.

classes.name: StreamingAudioPlayer
classes.description: A class extended to conform to the StreamingAudioPlaying protocol.

classes.name: PCMStreamingAudioPlayer
classes.description: A class extended to conform to the PCMStreamingAudioPlaying protocol.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Initiates playback of a streaming audio asynchronously, returning a StreamingPlaybackResult.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback and returns an optional Double, potentially representing the playback position or duration.
